title: RDSO TL 0091 Testing Lab | Railway LED Lights
description: RDSO TL 0091 testing in India for railway LED luminaires. Test vibration, IP65, environmental, EMC and electrical performance services with ITC India

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: ITC India provides RDSO TL 0091 testing support for energy-efficient LED based luminaire units used in Indian Railways passenger coaches. RDSO currently lists RDSO/PE/SPEC/TL/0091-2026 (Rev. 2) as the specification for energy-efficient LED based luminaire units for passenger coaches.

Railway luminaires operate where vibration, shock, temperature variation, humidity and electrical disturbances can affect reliability. Testing helps manufacturers evaluate whether LED luminaires, drivers, enclosures and mounting arrangements meet specified electrical, photometric, environmental and mechanical requirements.

sections.heading: What Is RDSO/PE/SPEC/TL/0091-2026 (Rev. 2)?
paragraphs: RDSO TL 0091 defines requirements for LED based luminaire units used in passenger coaches. It covers applications such as passenger areas, corridors, doorways, gangways, lavatories, berth reading lights and indication lights.

The specification addresses construction, electrical characteristics, illumination performance, environmental durability and safety-related requirements. Manufacturers should confirm the latest applicable specification, drawing, amendment and purchaser requirement before finalising a test programme.

sections.heading: Tests Under RDSO TL 0091
paragraphs: Depending on the luminaire and required prototype, type, acceptance or routine test scope, testing can include visual and dimensional checks, electrical measurements, power-factor and harmonic evaluation, insulation and high-voltage checks, surge and reverse-polarity evaluation, temperature-rise testing, colour-rendering and illumination measurements, fire-retardant assessment, ingress protection, vibration and shock, climatic testing, EMC evaluation, endurance and safety checks.
The exact clause-wise test matrix should be agreed against the current RDSO specification and purchase requirement before testing.

sections.heading: Vibration and Shock Testing
paragraphs: Railway lighting equipment is exposed to vibration generated by track conditions, vehicle movement and mounting location. Mechanical stresses can loosen fasteners, damage PCB assemblies, affect solder joints or cause intermittent failures.

ITC India also provides IEC 61373 vibration testing for rolling-stock equipment. Testing the complete luminaire with its driver and mounting arrangement helps assess its resistance to the mechanical railway environment.

sections.heading: Environmental Testing for Railway LED Luminaires
paragraphs: Temperature and humidity can influence LED output, driver electronics, insulation, seals and enclosure materials. RDSO TL 0091 therefore includes environmental evaluation within the qualification programme.

ITC India provides dedicated RDSO environmental testing for LED based luminaires and broader environmental testing services for electrical and electronic equipment. Depending on the test plan, evaluation may include dry heat, damp heat, cold and other climatic exposures with functional checks.

IEC 60571 is also relevant to electronic equipment used on rolling stock. Manufacturers can review ITC India’s IEC 60571 testing services when a project includes additional railway electronic equipment requirements.

sections.heading: IP65 and Enclosure Protection Testing
paragraphs: Where IP65 protection is required, the applicable luminaire enclosure is evaluated for protection against dust and water ingress. This helps assess protection of LED modules, drivers and electrical connections against contamination and moisture.
ITC India provides IP testing laboratory services for electrical and electronic enclosures under IEC 60529 and related requirements.

sections.heading: EMC and Electrical Performance
paragraphs: LED drivers used in railway coaches must operate reliably in an electrically demanding environment. Depending on the applicable RDSO test matrix, EMC testing may form part of product qualification.

ITC India’s EMC/EMI testing laboratory supports emission and immunity evaluation for electrical and electronic products. Electrical characteristics, protection functions and operating performance should be checked using the supply conditions and acceptance criteria specified for the luminaire.

sections.heading: Products Covered
paragraphs: RDSO TL 0091 applies to LED luminaire units intended for passenger coaches, including cabin and passenger-area lighting, corridor and doorway lighting, gangway luminaires, lavatory lights, berth reading lights, night lights and indication luminaires, subject to the applicable luminaire type and drawing.

sections.heading: Why Choose ITC India?
paragraphs: ITC India supports railway product manufacturers with environmental, vibration, ingress-protection, EMC and electrical testing facilities. A coordinated test plan helps establish the correct specimen configuration, mounting arrangement, operating condition and acceptance criteria.
For accreditation-specific reports, manufacturers should confirm that the required clause and revision are included in the laboratory’s current approved scope.

sections.heading: Request RDSO TL 0091 Testing
paragraphs: For a quotation, provide the luminaire type, drawing number, rated voltage and wattage, applicable RDSO revision, required test clauses, sample quantity and any purchaser-specific acceptance requirements.
Send your RDSO TL 0091 testing requirement to ITC India for technical review and test planning.

sections.heading: What is RDSO TL 0091?
paragraphs: RDSO TL 0091 is the Indian Railways specification for energy-efficient LED based luminaire units used in passenger coaches.

sections.heading: What is the latest RDSO TL 0091 revision?
paragraphs: RDSO currently lists RDSO/PE/SPEC/TL/0091-2026 (Rev. 2). Manufacturers should verify the latest issue and amendments before testing.

sections.heading: Does RDSO TL 0091 require vibration testing?
paragraphs: The specification includes vibration and shock evaluation for applicable qualification stages, with railway vibration requirements linked to IEC 61373.

sections.heading: Does RDSO TL 0091 include IP65 testing?
paragraphs: IP protection is included for applicable luminaire assemblies where required. Confirm applicability for the specific luminaire type and current revision.

sections.heading: What information is needed for a quotation?
paragraphs: Provide the luminaire type, drawing number, electrical ratings, specification revision, required clauses, sample quantity and purchaser requirements.
